body.statement: For every mesh \(h=1/m\), \(\mathcal T_h(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\subseteq\mathcal T(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\) and \(d_H^{\|\cdot\|_\infty}(\mathcal T_h(P_{\mathrm{obs}}),\mathcal T(P_{\mathrm{obs}}))\le2(Lh+Mh^\beta)\). The bound is uniform over \(P\in\mathfrak P\), including laws for which \(u_{a,z}\) has intervals or isolated points of zeros.
body.justification: Two-sided Hausdorff control converts a numerical grid into a certified approximation to the entire sharp set.
body.gap: Chiang et al. control sieve approximation inside confidence inequalities, but do not prove two-sided sup-norm Hausdorff approximation for a changing obstacle capacity.
body.consumer: An analyst can choose \(h\) to guarantee that computational error is smaller than a prespecified clinical effect margin.
